message: Power outages can feel like an unexpected adventure, can't they? I’ve found that when the lights go out, it’s a great chance to rediscover some good old-fashioned fun—like board games, storytelling, or even cozy candlelit dinners. It’s also smart to be prepared for those moments, so I’ve come across a handy resource that offers tips on how to stay safe and entertained during a blackout. How do you like to pass the time when the power's out?
